movie.title: I Know Who You Are
movie.overview: On 1949 October 1, the day of the founding ceremony of the People's Republic of China, Xiao Dali enters the city and is reorganized as the director of the public security police station. He finds that primary school teacher Feng Jingbo is full of doubts. With the high vigilance of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security official, Dali insists on partnering with Feng and becomes his neighbor. He then spends his whole life carrying out a nearly four-decade pursuit without regrets.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Upon the founding of the People's Republic of China, a dedicated public security officer devotes four decades of his life to monitoring and pursuing a suspicious local schoolteacher.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: On October 1, 1949, newly assigned police station director Xiao Dali enters the city and immediately grows suspicious of primary school teacher Feng Jingbo. Driven by a soldier's vigilance and a deep sense of duty, Dali moves next door to Feng to keep a close watch on his daily activities. Over the course of nearly forty years, their intertwined lives turn into a quiet, lifelong game of cat-and-mouse. Through political shifts and passing decades, Dali remains unwavering in his pursuit to unmask the truth.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The story opens on October 1, 1949, the historical day marking the founding of the People's Republic of China. Xiao Dali, a seasoned soldier, transitions into civil service as he is appointed the director of a local public security police station in the newly reorganized city. Shortly after taking office, Dali encounters Feng Jingbo, a seemingly ordinary primary school teacher whose behavior and background arouse deep suspicion. Guided by his refined instincts as a combat veteran and an unyielding commitment to public security, Dali determines that Feng bears watching. To maintain constant surveillance, Dali strategically takes up residence right next door to the teacher, entering into his immediate personal orbit. What begins as a routine investigation gradually transforms into an enduring, multi-decade confrontation embedded within the neighborhood's evolving social fabric. Over the span of nearly forty years, both men experience the profound political, economic, and cultural transformations sweeping across China. Despite the passage of time and changing personal circumstances, Dali never abandons his post or loses sight of his target. His relentless dedication turns the neighborhood dynamic into an extraordinary, lifelong investigation defined by patience, vigilance, and duty.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of modern Chinese history beginning on October 1, 1949, this drama chronicles the lifelong tension between a committed law enforcement officer and a mystery-shrouded civilian. When Xiao Dali takes charge of a city public security station on the day of the nation's founding, his sharp instincts lead him to investigate primary school teacher Feng Jingbo. To unearth the reality behind his suspicions, Dali becomes Feng's direct neighbor, initiating a subtle psychological contest that spans nearly four decades. The narrative offers a reflective look at police dedication, neighborly dynamics, and how personal duty intersects with historical change over the course of a lifetime.

story_structure.climax: The psychological chess match between the officer and the schoolteacher reaches its peak when critical long-hidden secrets come to light, forcing a final reckoning after decades of tension.
story_structure.conflict: Driven by his duty as a public security officer, Dali develops a persistent suspicion regarding Feng Jingbo's true identity and intentions, choosing to live as his neighbor to maintain close oversight.
story_structure.resolution: Decades of dedicated pursuit come to a definitive close, illustrating the quiet resolution and lifelong impact of Xiao Dali's unwavering commitment to his duty.
story_structure.introduction: On October 1, 1949, newly assigned police station director Xiao Dali enters the city following the founding of the People's Republic of China and crosses paths with primary school teacher Feng Jingbo, whose suspicious background immediately draws Dali's attention.
story_structure.risingAction: As years turn into decades, Dali maintains relentless surveillance over Feng, navigating shifting social landscapes while carefully uncovering clues and unraveling the mystery surrounding his neighbor's past.
